action.name: Nothing: the transcript is the workflow's work

description: #73: the Hebrew lane beside pocket-transcribe. When pocketsync lands a recording not marked en (Pocket leaves most Hebrew recordings unlabelled), runs transcribe-file-he on its audio into the transcripts_dir variable, on the stt-he actor (zipformer). The two lanes write separate files and fail separately. One run per audio at a time (concurrency key stt-he:<audio_sha256>). Ships disabled (docs/operations/pocket-transcribe.md).
name: Transcribe each landed Pocket recording in Hebrew
